brief: HDPE Southeast Asia prices from December 2025 to March 2026

sections.title: HDPE Southeast Asia Price Movement (Dec 2025 - Mar 2026)
questions: What were the assessed HDPE Southeast Asia CFR spot prices for each month from December 2025 to March 2026?
Are there any gaps or missing values in the price series for these months?
sections.tool_rationale: 'describe_corpus' confirms the coverage and any gaps in the price series; 'query_price_series' retrieves the actual monthly price values for the specified period.
sections.unanswerable_if: If the HDPE|Southeast Asia CFR|Spot price series does not cover December 2025 to March 2026, or if all months in this range are missing values.

sections.title: Gaps and Conflicts in HDPE Southeast Asia Price Data (Dec 2025 - Mar 2026)
questions: Which months in the requested period lack price data for HDPE Southeast Asia CFR spot?
Is there any explanation for missing data in the corpus?
sections.tool_rationale: 'describe_corpus' identifies months with missing data; 'query_price_series' confirms which months are affected and whether any explanation is available in the metadata.
sections.unanswerable_if: If the corpus does not indicate which months are missing or provide any metadata on gaps.

excluded.topic: Price forecast or outlook for HDPE Southeast Asia after March 2026
excluded.reason: The corpus only contains historical price assessments up to August 2026 and explicitly does not publish forecasts or outlooks.
